description: A volunteer in a blue VFW shirt and cap helps a child move a dark duffel bag/bedding item in a bedroom, with other volunteers visible in the background.

description: High-angle aerial shot of a large crowd of marchers -- many in shorts and boots, carrying flags, one person in a distinctive purple robe/costume -- walking along a wet street beside a stone building.

description: A bearded man in a black wide-brim hat holds up a waving American flag on a pole while walking with a group of backpack-laden marchers on a bridge/walkway, with AT&T Stadium visible in the background.

notable_details: Same shot used in both companion cuts of this campaign, appears to be a signature b-roll clip.

description: Close-up of a laughing young man holding a red Marine Corps flag (eagle, globe, and anchor emblem) beside another man in tactical gear, with a third man in sunglasses visible behind them.
notable_details: Joyful expression; good candidate for a highlight reel moment; same shot used in the companion 60-second cut.

description: High-angle aerial shot looking down at a crowd of marchers with backpacks walking along a brick building arcade/sidewalk, with a bold red title card reading 'STILL ADVANCING' wiped in over white space to the right.
notable_details: Closing title card of this cut, held for the last ~7.5 seconds; note this cut ends on 'STILL ADVANCING' whereas the companion 60-second cut ends on a different 'STILL SERVING' end card, suggesting these are alternate campaign taglines.
